The subject is frozen by identity before material reference exposure; the assessor records its expectations from the governing source before opening the candidate; it reads the subject at a named immutable identity, never a working tree; it makes no repair; it does not assess its own authorship.
Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.
The benchmark is the observable for the comparative baseline's criteria F27 and F28; F29 and F30 are the same observation reported with the task completed, the material errors detected and the cost.
A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a violation, whatever the size of the delta.
A claim names its subject, the property claimed, its basis, the relation between witness and claim, and its falsifier.

A claim's quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed its evaluated evidence; generalising a local observation needs a declared inference relation, the comparable population and explicit counterexample treatment.

Every claim of the predecessor cut receives exactly one disposition in this corpus: conserved (restated in the corpus's own text with every determination, locus named; a route to the predecessor is provenance, never the disposition), superseded (an accepted successor relation, named), intentionally removed (Jim's decision with reason; no Writer records it), not applicable (bounded reason), or unresolved (the only other state; blocks qualification of the affected claim). A reframing note is commentary on the carrying. A clause with no predecessor row is new law and names the purpose and material relation that require it.

A closed result identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual uncertainty and the invalidation conditions; the minimal shape is REFERENCE_FRAME section 13.
P4b, P0
A work item closes by the condition it stated, not by a reviewer's approval; a reviewer result is an input to closure, never the closure.
Compute the material closure of the seed set under the relation family on the exact basis; if the closure is not finite and unique, the step returns a gap or refusal and does not guess.

A composite over several results declares its conjunction; the member it reports is chosen by that declared rule; every known failure and uncovered obligation survives the join and is carried with the composite; no universal order among the non-satisfied members exists.
candidate_ready -> satisfied; refused -> falsified; incomplete -> indeterminate; re_entry_requested -> out_of_frame or invalid_basis.

For the context dimension the fit test is a measurement: the bytes of the selected context are measured before any read and compared with the declared cap; the measurement, the cap and the outcome are step-produced facts recorded before the read.

The core statement is the one-sentence route into the method: interpretation (FOUNDATIONS P1), purpose and contract (P2, SPEC_METHOD section 3), transformation under authority conserving material relations (P4a, P4b, ACTIVATION sections 2 and 4), evaluation of claims (EVALUATION), continuation and recovery from current state (ACTIVATION section 5).
Startup, framework, external computation, transport and assurance costs are separated so that one cannot conceal another; supported input dimensions and workloads are declared before qualification.

Diagnosis asks, in this order: 1 Was the correct declared frame activated? 2 Were the subject and basis exact? 3 Was the actor inside the capability envelope? 4 Was admissible evidence available? 5 Is a material variable or invariant missing from the frame? 6 Is a required conjunction or translation missing? 7 Is the evaluation family itself wrong or incomplete? 8 Is another frame required? The order prevents every difficult evaluation from creating another frame.
P2
accept, local_repair, re_enter and reject are what the decision owner does with an assessed candidate; a disposition consumes a core result and is not one.
A valid parse, a valid map, a green test and a historical judgment each establish exactly their own claim.
A composite with a known failure or an uncovered required obligation cannot project success; a known failure A and an uncovered obligation B survive every join.
The selected context fits the envelope.
Activate.

If it does not fit, one or more of these, in combination: refine the outer contract into steps whose contexts fit; sequence activations; apply a lawful compression; select another actor whose envelope fits; or return out_of_frame.
The grant names the operations permitted, the territory that may change, and the decisions reserved to others.

The actor may own its internal reasoning and search where the governing method permits. It returns through the declared result relation. Hidden internal reasoning is no substitute for required evidence, provenance or authority. Frame size is optimised for reliable evaluation, not for maximum context loading: a more capable actor may activate a broader frame and a less capable one may use a lawful refinement sequence, and both preserve the same material invariants and authority relations.
An indeterminate result names the evidence that would decide, as its residual uncertainty.
P5; rc.2 RF #return-a-closed-result
Declared inputs are acquired by their exact identity; a declared input absent from the actor's materialised view is neither licence to read elsewhere nor evidence that it is absent.
A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory.

The intake names: the governed outcome or decision it serves; the exact workspace subject and basis, and the inputs it may acquire, each by identity and hash or by an input commit; the evaluation or evaluation family and its result algebra; the affected relation set and the invariants that govern it; the applicable frame-set, semantic, evaluation, operation where material, and decision authority, and the grant (operations permitted, territory that may change, decisions reserved to others); the available actor capability envelopes; the conditions that make the result stale or out of scope and those that require re-entry at an owning relation; and, where the governed question is capability fit or a cost claim, the allowance and how spend will be measured.
The actor's internal path within a step is not part of the output and is not governed.
Green labels, document counts, review counts and historical outcomes are not acceptance.

Semantic law defines what an evaluation means; evidence supplies observations; the evaluator applies the declared relation; decision authority disposes; one actor may perform several and the record keeps them distinguishable.

A load-bearing claim names its exact subject, the property, the governing basis, the witness relation, the nearest weaker property it excludes, and its falsifier, before a witness is selected; without these it is evidence discovery, not proof.

The method is qualified the way it qualifies anything else: a fresh competent constructor, inside a declared envelope, using only the declared ordinary method and authority surfaces and declared trial subjects, with material reference outcomes, incumbent realisations, author memory and ad hoc rescue withheld until freeze wherever earlier exposure would compromise reconstructive independence; then an independent evaluator compares the frozen result with the method's mandatory relation population.

Standing: conserves Method Self-Qualification, which leaves the constructor, freeze and assessor protocols to the governing authority, and RF-013 for reconstructability; the surfaces rule and the conditional withholding conserve UP-022's qualification protocol.

The boundary between out_of_frame and indeterminate is drawn on what the activated frame declares and on what the step did with it. out_of_frame when the claim requires a material relation or an evaluator capability that the activated frame does not declare; whether the step exercised anything is irrelevant to this member, the ground is the missing declaration. indeterminate when every relation and capability the claim requires is declared and was exercised in the step, and the admissible evidence still cannot decide. These two cases restate RF-012's members with the boundary made explicit; a declared capability the step did not exercise is a third case and a member of neither.
P5; rc.2 RF #rf-012-closed-results
The method does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
A missing, failed or out-of-scope result returns its own member, never satisfied.
An out_of_frame result names the missing relation or capability, its owner where the subject gives one, and the reconfiguration pressure it creates under ACTIVATION section 4.
P5; rc.2 RF #reconfigure-when-necessary
A finite actor realises a selected outer contract through steps; each step's selected context fits the actor's envelope; the actor's internal path within a step is its own.
Standing: recovered as a composite; the generic statement is reframed from the graph profile's graph functions.
A selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit material obligations from the transformation they serve.
Standing: independent. Identical capacity serves opposite purposes.
Judgments, residuals, observations and authority decisions the outer contract needs are recorded by the step that produced them.

Standing: derived; reframed from AC-009, AC-013, AC-005, UP-017 and UP-021, whose nine statements of conservation become one obligation with typed instances (authority, residual, judgment, frame, transition, successor claim, evidence by reference); each source clause continues to govern its own scope.

A step can meet a condition outside its context and cannot report success on one; its result algebra carries indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis as first-class outcomes and its control model names the next move.
Standing: derived.
Definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.
Standing: independent. A bounded actor satisfying all else can still take a green label as acceptance.
The actor of one step need not be the actor of the next; a later actor may re-acquire declared sources but not a prior actor's private memory.
A step's output is a candidate until evaluated.
The world is open: a step may meet conditions outside its selected context.
P0 presupposes a selected outcome (P2).
A document set that requires private validator knowledge, whole-corpus loading or a prior actor's memory fails the benchmark regardless of its content.

Project the closure to the selected context, recording its boundary: the excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams; material not in the closure stays out; adjacent material does not enter because it exists.

A human decision may be exercised directly or through an explicitly admitted bounded proxy whose grant names its scope and exclusions; a proxy cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing authority or accepted design; such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

Each clause names the principle that requires it (P0 to P6) and, where it restates or supersedes an rc.2 clause, may carry that clause's route as provenance; a route is never the disposition. The corpus is applicable without the rc.2 cut, which remains the operative builder of this construction until STDO 3 is released.

An out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or incompatible result causes one of: supply the missing admissible evidence; select another actor inside the frame's capability envelope; activate another existing frame; refine or extend a frame declaration; revise the frame set (REFERENCE_FRAME section 10); change the evaluation; or re-enter the governing product or method relation. The disposition follows the cause; a difficult evaluation alone does not prove that another frame is required.
P5, P2

For a selected activation, measure whether a fresh actor given only the published documents recovers the governing relations with fidelity judged independently, and at what reconstruction cost (context transferred, time, and spend where measurable), against the rc.2 corpus as baseline.
Standing: new; derived from P0 with the actor-change premise.

A recoverability case gives a fresh actor only this corpus for a bounded activation on a declared subject, with the same task against the rc.2 corpus as baseline; a second case withholds validator folklore, author memory and whole-corpus loading, and the activation still succeeds or returns out_of_frame truthfully.
A declared refinement answers a different question, keeps its own vocabulary and declares a total mapping to the core; no refinement adds a core member.
One core algebra of exactly these five members serves every evaluation and every step's stop state.
A review recommends a disposition; it does not apply one.

Every known relation whose lawful change can alter the evaluation result, the validity of the basis, the sufficiency of evidence, operation authority or decision authority appears in the frame or enters through a declared authoritative input. Omitting a material relation makes the frame insufficient. The law does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
P2; P0 with the open-world premise

Every evaluation returns a member of its declared result algebra. The core algebra is defined once, in ACTIVATION section 3 (satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame, invalid_basis) with the no-coercion rule; this member does not define it a second time. An externally owned compatible extension may refine that algebra while preserving explicit indeterminate, out-of-frame and invalid-basis pressure; it may neither add a core member nor coerce one to success.
P5

A fresh competent actor inside the declared capability envelope can reconstruct the activated evaluation from the frame declaration, the exact subject, the basis and the admissible inputs, without undocumented conversational or historical context.
P0 with the actor-change premise

A reader selects the route for their purpose (understand the method; do a bounded piece of work; review someone's work; decide acceptance or release; apply the method to a domain; load it into a model's context) and reads the named documents and sections in order; the document map names which file owns which obligations.
Capability fit or a cost claim is the governed question.
The activation declares its allowance and reports spend with its measurement source, or records that the counter is unavailable.
Standing: new (P0 with UP-014's selection rule).

A step is the activation of one reference frame, or one declared active frame configuration, on an exact subject. Its context is the projection of that activated frame to the actor; the corpus or the workspace is never the context. Intake, admission, applicability and activation are distinct relations inside the step even when one invocation performs all of them.
A step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts (judgments with evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance) and one stop state from the result algebra.

A step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable, is not a step-produced fact, and is governed by sufficiency, not conservation.
For required obligations R and admitted coverage C, uncovered coverage is R minus C; combining results takes the union of known failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

A term the claim depends on and the frame leaves undefined is an undeclared material relation: its meaning can alter the result and it enters through no declared input. A claim that depends on such a term is out_of_frame on the ground of the missing declaration.

A declared capability that the step did not exercise yields no Reference Frame Method result for the evaluation at all: the claim is unresolved, not out of frame and not indeterminate, as a missing premise leaves a question unresolved rather than false. The step's stop state is incomplete under the construction availability refinement, its work state carries the unexercised capability as a residual, and the actor says so rather than selecting a core member; an actor cannot report an evaluation it did not perform. The evaluation's result and the step's stop state answer different questions, so the mapping of incomplete to the core does not make the evaluation indeterminate. This third case is a tightening RF-012 does not name.
P5, P6; rc.2 RF #applicability-and-required-results

Packaging, syntax, compilation, presence, invocation or local behaviour never substitutes for a semantic, authority-bearing, installed or end-to-end claim because the weaker property is easier to measure.

arguments.literal: For a selected activation, measure whether a fresh actor given only the published documents recovers the governing relations with fidelity judged independently, and at what reconstruction cost (context transferred, time, and spend where measurable), against the rc.2 corpus as baseline.
Standing: new; derived from P0 with the actor-change premise.

clauses.statement: The recoverability benchmark measures fresh-actor recovery of the governing relations, judged independently, and its reconstruction cost against the rc.2 baseline.

arguments.literal: A recoverability case gives a fresh actor only this corpus for a bounded activation on a declared subject, with the same task against the rc.2 corpus as baseline; a second case withholds validator folklore, author memory and whole-corpus loading, and the activation still succeeds or returns out_of_frame truthfully.

clauses.statement: Recoverability cases run a fresh actor on this corpus against the rc.2 baseline, with private knowledge withheld.

arguments.literal: A declared refinement answers a different question, keeps its own vocabulary and declares a total mapping to the core; no refinement adds a core member.

clauses.statement: Each refinement keeps its vocabulary and maps totally to the core; none adds a core member.

arguments.literal: One core algebra of exactly these five members serves every evaluation and every step's stop state.

clauses.statement: One core algebra of five members serves every evaluation and stop state.

arguments.literal: A review recommends a disposition; it does not apply one.

clauses.statement: A review recommends a disposition and does not apply one.

arguments.literal: Every known relation whose lawful change can alter the evaluation result, the validity of the basis, the sufficiency of evidence, operation authority or decision authority appears in the frame or enters through a declared authoritative input. Omitting a material relation makes the frame insufficient. The law does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
P2; P0 with the open-world premise

clauses.statement: RF-003: every known material relation is in the frame or enters through a declared input; omission makes the frame insufficient; no proof of no undiscovered relation is required.

arguments.literal: Every evaluation returns a member of its declared result algebra. The core algebra is defined once, in ACTIVATION section 3 (satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame, invalid_basis) with the no-coercion rule; this member does not define it a second time. An externally owned compatible extension may refine that algebra while preserving explicit indeterminate, out-of-frame and invalid-basis pressure; it may neither add a core member nor coerce one to success.
P5

clauses.statement: RF-012: every evaluation returns a member of its declared algebra, defined once in ACTIVATION section 3; extensions preserve non-success pressure and add no core member.

arguments.literal: A fresh competent actor inside the declared capability envelope can reconstruct the activated evaluation from the frame declaration, the exact subject, the basis and the admissible inputs, without undocumented conversational or historical context.
P0 with the actor-change premise

clauses.statement: RF-013: a fresh competent actor reconstructs the activated evaluation from declaration, subject, basis and admissible inputs, without undocumented history.

arguments.literal: A reader selects the route for their purpose (understand the method; do a bounded piece of work; review someone's work; decide acceptance or release; apply the method to a domain; load it into a model's context) and reads the named documents and sections in order; the document map names which file owns which obligations.

clauses.statement: A reader follows the route for their purpose; the map says which file owns what.

arguments.literal: Capability fit or a cost claim is the governed question.
The activation declares its allowance and reports spend with its measurement source, or records that the counter is unavailable.
Standing: new (P0 with UP-014's selection rule).

clauses.statement: Spend is reported with its measurement source, or the counter is recorded as unavailable (new in this corpus).

arguments.literal: A step is the activation of one reference frame, or one declared active frame configuration, on an exact subject. Its context is the projection of that activated frame to the actor; the corpus or the workspace is never the context. Intake, admission, applicability and activation are distinct relations inside the step even when one invocation performs all of them.

clauses.statement: A step activates one frame or configuration on an exact subject; its context is the frame's projection, never the corpus or workspace; intake, admission, applicability and activation are distinct relations inside it.

arguments.literal: A step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts (judgments with evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance) and one stop state from the result algebra.

clauses.statement: A step outputs a candidate, its step-produced facts and one stop state.

arguments.literal: A step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable, is not a step-produced fact, and is governed by sufficiency, not conservation.

clauses.statement: A step-produced fact is one that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; reproducible observations are re-acquirable and governed by sufficiency.

arguments.literal: For required obligations R and admitted coverage C, uncovered coverage is R minus C; combining results takes the union of known failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

clauses.statement: Uncovered coverage is R minus C; combination unions failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

arguments.literal: A term the claim depends on and the frame leaves undefined is an undeclared material relation: its meaning can alter the result and it enters through no declared input. A claim that depends on such a term is out_of_frame on the ground of the missing declaration.

clauses.statement: A term the claim depends on that the frame leaves undefined is an undeclared material relation, and the claim is out_of_frame.

arguments.literal: A declared capability that the step did not exercise yields no Reference Frame Method result for the evaluation at all: the claim is unresolved, not out of frame and not indeterminate, as a missing premise leaves a question unresolved rather than false. The step's stop state is incomplete under the construction availability refinement, its work state carries the unexercised capability as a residual, and the actor says so rather than selecting a core member; an actor cannot report an evaluation it did not perform. The evaluation's result and the step's stop state answer different questions, so the mapping of incomplete to the core does not make the evaluation indeterminate. This third case is a tightening RF-012 does not name.
P5, P6; rc.2 RF #applicability-and-required-results

clauses.statement: A declared but unexercised capability yields no evaluation result: the claim is unresolved, the step stops incomplete carrying the unexercised capability as a residual, and the actor says so rather than selecting a core member.

arguments.literal: Packaging, syntax, compilation, presence, invocation or local behaviour never substitutes for a semantic, authority-bearing, installed or end-to-end claim because the weaker property is easier to measure.

clauses.statement: A weaker property never substitutes for the claimed one because it is easier to measure.

frame_indexes.scope: A fresh actor given only the published documents performs a bounded evaluation step: the route in, the intake, the measured fit, the five-member result with evidence, the separation of claim, evidence, judgment and authority, the stop state and the handoff; with reconstruction cost measured. Selected for the R-01 and R-02 cases.

residuals.detail: The envelope has four dimensions (context, attention, time, capability). The context dimension is measured in bytes before any read; attention, time and capability have no measure or declaration format, and the documents do not say how a step records that the test was performed on those dimensions.

Each independent commitment carries a one-sentence non-entailment argument in its qualification. These are claims of independence with an informal witness each; none is formalised and P4a states none. The accepted C1 realisation argues them at greater length; the standard conserves only the sentence.

Every encoded clause's rc.2 disposition is carried in the documents as a route, not in this program: the program's source basis is the tenant standards directory and rc.2 members are outside it. Conservation of an rc.2 clause therefore cannot be checked by this program's validation; it remains a semantic judgment over the documents and their routes.

symbols.label: Acceptance: the decision owner's disposition over an unchanged subject, exhausting only the instance and interval it names

Activated frame: one frame declaration bound to an exact evaluation, workspace subject, basis, actor and evidence-acquisition boundary; a reusable declaration is not evidence that a particular activation was correct

Activation packet: the minimum an actor receives on activation: one activated frame or one declared active frame configuration with its identity, evaluation, subject, relations, authorities, evidence, envelope, exclusions, dependencies and stop conditions
Actor: whoever performs a step within a declared capability envelope (context, attention, time, capability)
Allowance: declared resource bound and spend measurement where capability fit or cost is the governed question
Independent assessment protocol: freeze, expectations, named identity, no repair, no own authorship

Authority: an identity-bearing permission to operate or to dispose acceptance within a scope; never minted from capability, label or reachability; its kinds are frame-set, semantic, evaluation, operation and decision authority

Basis: the exact state a step, claim, result or evaluation binds: every version, identity, time, topology, authority, configuration or evidence coordinate whose change can alter it; immutable, or moving with a declared way of detecting advancement and a declared reevaluation condition; mixed bases need an explicit composite relation
Candidate: a step's output before evaluation
Change class: goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice, design_reframe or realization_refactor, each with its re-entry point
Claim: an assertion with subject, property, basis, witness relation and falsifier

Disposition of a predecessor claim in this corpus (UP-015 applied to the corpus itself): conserved, superseded, intentionally removed, not applicable with a bounded reason, or unresolved; a reframing note is commentary on the carrying, never a disposition

Closed result: identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual uncertainty and the invalidation conditions; minimal shape REFERENCE_FRAME section 13; available for reuse under an applicability check
Closure condition: the condition a work item stated for its own closure
Constructor: the relation that produces the candidate and self-review

The method's core statement: interpret a scoped subject; select a purpose and governing contract; transform within admitted authority while conserving its material relations; evaluate the resulting claims; continue, recover or conclude from current state under explicit uncertainty
Cost categories kept separate: startup, framework, external computation, transport, assurance
Required obligation set R, admitted coverage C and uncovered coverage R minus C
Decision owner: the relation that disposes
Diagnostic order: the eight questions asked in order before another frame is created
Document map: the seven law documents (FOUNDATIONS, REFERENCE_FRAME, ACTIVATION, EVALUATION, SPEC_METHOD, CONFORMANCE, PROFILES), their tiers and what each owns

Capability envelope K (envelope B of ACTIVATION section 2): the competence, context capacity, tools, access, applicable independence conditions and configuration required to activate a frame; usable by one actor and not another; it can neither waive an invariant nor widen authority
Evaluator: the relation that applies the declared relation between law and evidence

Evidence: the exact observations or artifacts admitted to evaluate a claim on a basis, each with provenance, subject identity, basis and scope; availability inside a frame makes it neither semantic truth nor decision authority
Falsifier: the observation that would defeat a claim, named before a witness is selected
Fit test of the selected context against the envelope
Grant: operations permitted, territory that may change, decisions reserved to others

Intake: the activation record from which a step's governing relations are reconstructed without history; names the governed outcome, exact subject and basis with inputs by identity, the evaluation and its algebra, the affected relation set, the applicable authorities and the grant, the actor envelopes, staleness and re-entry conditions, and where governed the allowance

Material: of a relation, that its lawful change can change an evaluation's result, invalidate its basis, change the admissible evidence, or change who may perform a material operation or decide; evaluation-relative, so a relation material in one frame may be irrelevant in another
Material closure of Z under R on the exact basis
The comparative baseline's criteria F27 to F30: native representation, onboarding, effectiveness evidence, work and resource measurement
Qualification of the method itself: a fresh constructor inside a declared envelope, then an independent evaluator against the mandatory relation population
Outcome U: a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable state with an acceptance interval
P0 Bounded construction
P1 Interpretation
P2 Purpose
P3 Identity
P4a Typed composition
P4b Conservation of step-produced facts
P5 Totality
P6 Justification and authority
Proxy: an explicitly admitted bounded relation through which a human decision is exercised
falsified: a declared counterexample defeats it
indeterminate: admissible evidence cannot decide it
invalid_basis: the subject or basis cannot support the evaluation
out_of_frame: the evaluation needs an undeclared material relation or capability
satisfied: the declared predicate holds on the exact basis
The rc.2 builder corpus whose clauses this corpus conserves, reframes or supersedes
Reading route: for a stated purpose, the documents and sections to read in order
Reconfiguration: the disposition that follows an out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or incompatible result

Recoverability benchmark: whether a fresh actor given only the published documents recovers the governing relations, with fidelity judged independently and reconstruction cost measured against the rc.2 baseline
Recoverability case: a fresh actor given only this corpus, with private knowledge withheld

Reference frame: a finite specification of the attention, coordinates, authority, evidence and result relations required to perform one declared evaluation family over a stated basis; its components are the frame tuple
Refinement: ambiguity outcome (resolved, carried, escalated, blocked)
Refinement: construction availability (candidate_ready, refused, incomplete, re_entry_requested)
Refinement: disposition (accept, local_repair, re_enter, reject)
Refinement: profile-defined closure decisions
Relation family R: dependency relations whose change can alter the result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority
The one core result algebra for every evaluation and stop state
Review result: one core result per declared predicate with subject, basis, evidence, ranked findings, residual uncertainty, invalidation conditions and a recommended disposition
RF-003 Material sufficiency: a law every declared or activated frame obeys
RF-012 Closed results: a law every declared or activated frame obeys
RF-013 Reconstructable activation: a law every declared or activated frame obeys
Seed set Z: subject, outcome and affected relations named in the intake
Selected context: the projection of the closure with its recorded boundary seams
Semantic law: what an evaluation means
Step: one bounded unit of work (intake, selected context, grant, execution, output); the activation of one reference frame, or one declared active frame configuration, on an exact subject
Step-produced fact: a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; a reproducible observation is not one
Stop state: the one core result a step returns
Witness: the evidence selected to support a claim under a declared relation
Work state: current persistent workspace, governing basis, applicable closed results and judgments with their invalidators, residuals, and known uncertainty over external effects
